newsitem.title: USA: Duke, PanEnergy no shocker -- arbs.
newsitem.headline: Duke, PanEnergy no shocker -- arbs.

text.p: The expected retirement of William Grigg as chairman of Duke Power Co after Duke completes a $7.7 billion takeover of PanEnergy Corp was the biggest surprise of the deal's announcement Monday, aribtrageurs said.
The stock-swap valuing PanEnergy at $50 per share as of Friday's market close appears on the pricey side but was not surprising, they said.
"It is just a continuation of the consolidation we are seeing of the electric and natural gas industries with deregulation coming about," an arb said of the friendly pact.

"I think Duke is taking a hit. It is very dilutive and the companies are saying so, and the head of Duke is retiring at the close of the transction, and he is good. This is not a good thing either," a second arb said.
In the announcement, Duke said chairman and chief executive Grigg will retire once the transaction closes.
Richard Priory, Duke's president and chief operating officer, will become chairman and CEO of the combined company, to be renamed Duke Energy Corp.
Arbs said they expect the folding together of the electric generation and natural gas industries to continue, a trend that lit up the stocks of other natural gas companies.
As PanEnergy gained 1-1/4 to 43-1/2 -- after backing off a new all-time high of 45-3/8 -- and Williams Cos shot up to a new peak at 55-7/8 in early trade, then settled back to 55-1/2, up three.

Also in related trade, ENSERCH Corp gained 1/2 to 23-1/8, Coastal Corp added 3/8 to 48-1/8, Enron Corp rose 1-1/8 to 47, El Paso Energy Corp climbed 7/8 to 50-1/4 and Sonat Inc increased 7/8 to 53-3/4.
